children: T1 Energy Inc. (TE) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 12, 2026.

On November 12, 2026, T1 Energy Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), issued a press release announcing its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.

The information in this Item 2.02, including the Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"), except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1992243/000121390026118327/ea0311994-8k_t1energy.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1992243/000121390026118327/0001213900-26-118327-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
